model.description: applyPresentation(mode: 'expanded' | 'bar'): the bar <-> compartment flip on ONE component - expanded = full content []; bar = collapsed strip | of icons/verb-buttons from the SAME content. Branches ONLY presentation CSS; content + behavior FIXED (NOT two components). Reactive on the 'presentation' attr; bar-render is a private helper INSIDE this method (not its own Method); content hosted via slot/children (not a Method).
